item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 17/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an active southerly airstream, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days, and there will still be showers. The anticyclone aloft is expected to gradually cover the coast of southern China midweek next week, the weather will improve over the region and it will be hot.

Date/Month: 17/06 (Friday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms in the morning.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
